B
Applications like tumblr.com, which allow users to combine pictures, words and other media in creative ways and then share them, have the potential to add stickiness by amusing, entertaining and enlightening others.
诸如 tumblr.com 这类应用，能让用户以创造性方式组合图片、文字与其他媒介并分享出去，有潜力通过逗乐、娱乐和启发他人来增加用户黏性。

source_blocks.html:
参考范文

The cartoon vividly depicts two men reacting in opposite ways to the same spilled bottle. One buries his face in despair, crying, "It's all ruined!" while the other, relieved, exclaims, "Fortunately, there is still some left!" The contrast could not be sharper.

The drawing conveys a thought-provoking message: our attitude often matters more than the situation itself. Confronted with setbacks, pessimists fixate on what has been lost and sink into frustration, whereas optimists notice what remains and seek a way out. History abounds with examples showing that optimism is the very engine of perseverance, innovation and eventual success. Even a single spilled drop, seen through optimistic eyes, can still be salvaged.

From my perspective, we should all learn from the optimistic man. Life is bound to serve us spilled bottles now and then. Only by choosing to see the glass as half full can we keep up our morale, seize the remaining opportunities and march toward a brighter future.

【译文】

漫画生动地描绘了两人在面对同一只打翻的瓶子时截然不同的反应。一人绝望地埋下脸，喊道"全完了！"；另一人却如释重负地感叹："幸好还剩点儿！"对比之强烈，一目了然。

这幅画传达了发人深省的道理：态度往往比处境本身更重要。面对挫折，悲观者纠结于已失之物、陷入沮丧；而乐观者关注尚存之物、寻找出路。历史不乏其例：乐观正是坚持、创新与最终成功的引擎。即便是一滴洒出的水，用乐观的眼光看，也仍可挽回。

在我看来，我们都应向那位乐观者学习。人生难免时不时被递上一只打翻的瓶子。唯有选择"半满"的视角，我们才能保持斗志、抓住残存的机会，迈向更光明的未来。

paragraphs.html: Come on—Everybody's doing it. That whispered message, half invitation and half forcing, is what most of us think of when we hear the words peer pressure. 普利策奖得主罗森伯格给出了大量社会疗法付诸实践的例子：在南卡罗来纳州，一个由州政府资助、名为"向烟雾宣战"的反吸烟项目旨在让吸烟变得不再酷。在南非，一个名为"热爱生命"的艾滋病预防项目招募年轻人，在同伴中推广安全性行为。

The idea seems promising, and Rosenberg is a perceptive observer. Her critique of the lameness of many public-health campaigns is spot-on: they fail to mobilize peer pressure for healthy habits, and they demonstrate a seriously flawed understanding of psychology. "Dare to be different, please don't smoke!" pleads one billboard campaign aimed at reducing smoking among teenagers—teenagers, who desire nothing more than fitting in. 这个想法似乎很有前景，而罗森伯格也是一位敏锐的观察家。她对许多公共卫生运动蹩脚之处的批评一针见血：这些运动没能调动同伴压力来促成健康习惯，而且暴露出对心理学严重错误的理解。一个旨在减少青少年吸烟的广告牌活动呼吁道："敢于与众不同，请不要吸烟！"——可青少年最渴望的恰恰是融入群体。罗森伯格令人信服地指出，公共卫生倡导者应该向广告商学习，后者太擅长施加同伴压力了。

但在社会疗法的整体效果上，罗森伯格就不那么有说服力了。《加入俱乐部》充斥着太多无关细节，却没有充分探讨使同伴压力如此强大的社会和生物因素。这里所呈现的社会疗法最明显的缺陷是：它的效果持续不了多久。一旦州政府削减资金，"向烟雾宣战"就失败了。而"热爱生命"项目能否产生持久改变的证据既有限又褒贬不一。

There's no doubt that our peer groups exert enormous influence on our behavior. This is a subtle form of peer pressure: we unconsciously imitate the behavior we see every day.

Far less certain, however, is how successfully experts and bureaucrats can select our peer groups and steer their activities in virtuous directions. It's like the teacher who breaks up the troublemakers in the back row by pairing them with better-behaved classmates. The tactic never really works. And that's the problem with a social cure engineered from the outside: in the real world, as in school, we insist on choosing our own friends.

文章脉络：飞机/笔记本电脑/手机是天才们的发明→网络计算机是21世纪文化机器→但要警惕：它引发了下载与上传之间的秘密战争→所有动物都下载，只有人类会上传（创造物质和精神财富）→但大多数人仍卡在下载模式→电视是单向下载的，而网络计算机第一次提供了逆流而上、鼓励有意义上传的机会。

partb_options.head: Part B 选项原文（英汉对照）A–G

options.label: A
options.en: Of course, it is precisely these superfluous things that define human culture and ultimately what it is to be human. Downloading and consuming culture requires great skills, but failing to move beyond downloading is to strip oneself of a defining constituent of humanity.
options.zh: 当然，恰恰是这些多余之物定义了人类文化，并最终定义了何以为人。下载并消费文化需要很高的技巧，但止步于下载、不再超越，就等于剥夺了人性中一种决定性的构成要素。

options.label: B
options.en: Applications like tumblr.com, which allow users to combine pictures, words and other media in creative ways and then share them, have the potential to add stickiness by amusing, entertaining and enlightening others.
options.zh: 诸如 tumblr.com 这类应用，能让用户以创造性方式组合图片、文字与其他媒介并分享出去，有潜力通过逗乐、娱乐和启发他人来增加用户黏性。

options.label: C
options.en: Not only did they develop such a device but by the turn of the millennium they had also managed to embed it in a worldwide system accessed by billions of people every day.
options.zh: 他们不仅开发出了这样一种设备，而且到千禧年之际，还成功将其嵌入一个每天有数十亿人访问的全球系统之中。

options.label: D
options.en: This is because the networked computer has sparked a secret war between downloading and uploading - between passive consumption and active creation - whose outcome will shape our collective future in ways we can only begin to imagine.
options.zh: 这是因为联网计算机在"下载"与"上传"之间——亦即被动消费与主动创造之间——点燃了一场隐秘的战争，其结果将以我们才刚开始想象的方式塑造我们的共同未来。

options.label: E
options.en: The challenge the computer mounts to television thus bears little similarity to one format being replaced by another in the manner of record players being replaced by CD players.
options.zh: 因此，计算机对电视构成的挑战，与"唱片机被CD机取代"那种一种格式替代另一种格式的情形，几乎毫无相似之处。

options.label: F
options.en: One reason for the persistence of this pyramid of production is that for the past half-century, much of the world's media culture has been defined by a single medium - television - and television is defined by downloading.
options.zh: 这种生产金字塔之所以长久存在，原因之一在于过去半个世纪里，世界大部分媒介文化都由单一媒介——电视——所定义，而电视的本质就是下载。

options.label: G
options.en: The networked computer offers the first chance in 50 years to reverse the flow, to encourage thoughtful downloading and, even more importantly, meaningful uploading.
options.zh: 联网计算机提供了50年来首个扭转这一流向的机会，它鼓励审慎的下载，而更重要的是，鼓励有意义的"上传"。
